blueprints.name: Crimson Desert
blueprints.description: HP, MP, Stamina, Silver, Selected Item Amount, and game speed. Player stats use pointer chains — no scan needed. Economy values need a one-time scan per session.
blueprints.notes: Singleplayer only — Pearl Abyss confirmed no anti-cheat in SP mode. HP, MP, and Stamina resolve automatically via pointer chains. Silver and item amounts require a scan once per session using the Find Address wizard.

blueprints.name: Elden Ring
blueprints.description: HP, FP, Stamina, Runes, and game speed. Pointer chains verified for v1.15 (Shadow of the Erdtree). All player stats resolve automatically — no scan needed.
blueprints.notes: Singleplayer / offline only — EAC is active in online multiplayer. Pointer chains sourced from the veeenu/eldenring-practice-tool project. If a chain fails after a patch, use Find Address to locate the new value and report it.

blueprints.name: Minecraft (Java)
blueprints.description: Singleplayer survival helpers: health, hunger, XP level, selected stack count, movement speed.
blueprints.notes: Addresses vary with version, mods, and JVM state. Use Find Address per session where needed.

blueprints.name: Stardew Valley
blueprints.description: Money, health, energy, time-of-day, and selected stack count for singleplayer farms. Built around Warden's scan helper for quick setup.
blueprints.notes: Gold, time, and stack counts are exact-value scans. Health and energy narrow cleanly with decreasing scans after taking damage or spending stamina.

blueprints.name: Prison Architect
blueprints.description: Money, research, daily budget, and build speed. No anti-cheat. All addresses require a one-time scan per session — the game heap-allocates its objects.
blueprints.notes: No anti-cheat (singleplayer only, no VAC). Verified by WeMod, FLiNG, and community CE tables. Addresses shift every session — load a save first, then use Find Address to locate each value. Research is stored as a float: 0.0 = 0%, 1.0 = 100%.

blueprints.name: Hades
blueprints.description: Health plus core resource currencies like Obols, Darkness, Gemstones, and Chthonic Keys for offline runs.
blueprints.notes: Currencies are visible exact-value scans. Health works best with a decreasing scan after taking damage in an early chamber.

blueprints.name: Dark Souls III
blueprints.description: Community-derived pointer chains for HP, FP, Stamina, Souls, and game speed on current PC builds.
blueprints.notes: Set Steam to offline mode before attaching. If a pointer breaks after a patch, use Find Address once and report the drift.

blueprints.name: Lies of P
blueprints.description: Pointer-based HP, Legion, Stamina, Ergo, and game speed controls for current offline builds.
blueprints.notes: Built for offline usage. If a control stops updating after a patch, run Find Address once and update the chain.

blueprints.name: Schedule I
blueprints.description: Cash, notoriety, stamina, active product quantity, and day timer controls for offline runs.
blueprints.notes: Use exact scans for visible counters like cash and quantities. Use decreasing scans for stamina-like bars that tick down during sprinting or actions.
